scope: Full semantic, factual and source review of the 32 assigned technical, accessibility, checklist, security and cookie-audit sources.

findingsResolved: Missing robots.txt is no longer an automatic failure
Thin or empty pages require a purpose decision before noindex or removal
Rich Results Test is limited to Google-supported features and Schema.org Validator covers general vocabulary
16px and 1.5 line height are labelled design starting points rather than WCAG requirements
Reflow wording includes the WCAG exception for content requiring two-dimensional layout
CDN use is conditional on measured traffic and asset needs
Transparency checks accept a retention period or the criteria used to determine it
Data-portability export is expressly conditional on Article 20 applying

followUpResolutions.source: root final readback across four owned pages
findingsResolved: Report-template summaries and metrics no longer contradict the warning against unexplained aggregate scores
Robots and sitemap findings require tested scope and evidence instead of universal severity or copy-paste configuration
Security checklist file permissions are environment-specific
Accessibility checklist removes a fabricated implementation time and universal-user claim
Code audit recognises that Core Web Vitals fixes can involve assets, delivery configuration, servers or content as well as code
